_about: Dean's rule (27-28 Oct 2026): a council's general switchboard / contact-centre number is never a venue's direct line or its out-of-hours line, for shelters or warm spaces. scripts/council_switchboard.py blocks these in the contacts step, settle_council, the phone-lock guard and the publish gate. Approved locked out-of-hours lines (locked_ooh below) always win. Add a number here only with the council's own page showing it as the general/main number. Cardiff (#222) has no council line in shelters or warm spaces; its food bank cards are not touched by this check.
